have : ∀ᵐ ω ∈ Ω, Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|) ≤ Real.exp (t * X ω) + Real.exp (-t * X ω) := by
  intro ω
  rw [Real.exp_abs, Real.abs_mul]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp_add_exp_neg (t * X ω)
have h_integrable_sum : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω) + Real.exp (-t * X ω)) μ :=
  (MeasureTheory.Integrable.add ht_int_pos ht_int_neg)
apply (MeasureTheory.integrable_le_of_integrable ht_integrable_sum this)
